channel.title: Lullable — The Sleep Library
channel.description: Quiet, true things to read at night.

item.title: How long should it take to fall asleep?
item.description: Ten to twenty minutes is the healthy normal — and falling asleep instantly isn't the goal. What sleep latency is, and when it's worth attention.

item.title: The weather at the bottom of the sea
item.description: There is weather at the bottom of the Mariana Trench — currents, storms of sediment, warm springs. A quiet tour of the calmest climate on Earth.

item.title: What is low-arousal learning?
item.description: Audio engineered to sit just below the threshold of engagement — fascinating enough to hold a racing mind, calm enough to release it into sleep.

item.title: Why can't I stop thinking at night?
item.description: A racing mind at bedtime usually isn't insomnia — it's an unoccupied brain. Why silence backfires for overthinkers, and what actually works.
